summary:
Perm Krai is a federal subject of Russia and stands under the national framework on sexual orientation and gender identity set out in the UK Home Office country policy and information note (June 2025, assessment updated 11 June 2025).

No Perm Krai-specific law, court ruling, enforcement action, police practice or incident was identified. The one region-specific finding is survey data showing that respondents in the Volga area were more closeted toward relatives than the whole-study sample, which speaks to the social climate in the region rather than to any legal rule.
tangentialFactors: The Volga-area survey result is the only sub-national comparison available. It is a relative measure against the whole-study sample and does not quantify how many respondents were closeted, nor how many of them were in Perm Krai.
localsOnly: The Volga-area survey finding concerns disclosure to relatives, a resident-facing dimension of social climate. No Perm Krai-specific data on local services, employment, housing or healthcare access for trans residents was identified.
outOfScopeNotes: The Volga area covers several federal subjects, so the survey result cannot be attributed to Perm Krai specifically. No Perm Krai-level data on police conduct, hate-crime recording, prosecutions under the propaganda or extremism provisions, or access to gender-affirming care was located; whether any of these differ from the national pattern is unresolved.
